scholarship_title: ESU Padova / University of Padova Regional Study Grant 2026/2027
provider_organization: ESU Padova and the University of Padova (Veneto regional right-to-study grant)
eligible_nationalities: All (students enrolled at the University of Padova)

stipend.notes: Income- and merit-based cash grant; a student guide gives up to about EUR 8,246 a year for off-site students (not verified in the call)

additional_benefits: One daily meal at ESU canteens
Housing for eligible off-site students (per guide)

required_documents.name: Online application to the University of Padova regional grant call

preparation_alerts: International students usually need an ISEE parificato or equivalent income documents; check the call
